Clear-to-Trade customer journey

Complete English scenario catalogue. Synthetic case; proposed experience and human responsibility remain distinct.

Entity A, Australia · FX forward. Entity B, Singapore · reported parent. Person T works for B; authority for A is not established.

Return to Studio · View hero case ·

Establish the relationship · Separate entity and authority · Determine applicable requirements · Reuse permitted evidence · Request the specific missing facts · Assess evidence for its purpose · Define who and what to screen · Review a potential match · Assess enhanced due diligence when applicable · Investigate conflicts early · Prepare and review agreements · Assess credit risk and conditions · Remediate a precise finding · Understand open prerequisites · Record and communicate a scoped outcome

Provide limited contribution access

D3-ENTITY-06

Before

The process map does not specify portal or access-grant mechanics.

Pain point

Requiring full case access before someone can provide authority evidence may create a participation deadlock.

After · proposed

Use reviewed contact details and a narrowly scoped task grant for the appropriate contributor.

Opportunity

Contribute requested material without exposing the whole internal case.

An item-scoped contributor participation mechanism; portal/grant details are not specified by the PPT.
